chunks: It is easier for you to rectify what you missed by silence than to secure what you lost by speaking.
Retaining what is in a container is done by tightening its cover.
Retaining what is in your hands is more beloved to me than seeking what is in the hands of others.
The bitterness of disappointment is better than seeking from people.
Manual labour with chastity is better than riches with vice.
A man is the best guard of his own secret.
Often a man strives for what harms him.
He who speaks much speaks nonsense.
Associate with people of virtue; you will become one of them.
Keep aloof from people of vice; you will remain safe from them.
The worst food is that which is unlawful.
Oppressing the weak is the worst oppression.
Where leniency is unsuitable, harshness is lenience.
Often the ill-wisher gives correct advice
ai.seo_question: What are the key ethical teachings on speech and social conduct in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Delivered by Imam Hasan (peace be upon him) following the Treaty of Siffin, this passage reflects the strategic patience and introspective wisdom characteristic of the Ahl al-Bayt during the transition from military conflict to political consolidation. It offers practical guidance on mastering speech and self-sufficiency to avoid dependence on others, while highlighting the spiritual danger of consuming haram sustenance and the nuanced nature of effective counsel.

en.sayed-ali-raza: It is easier to rectify what you miss by silence than to secure what you lose by speaking.
Whatever is in a pot can be retained by closing the lid.
I should prefer you to retain what is in your hands rather to seek what is in other's hands.
Bitterness of disappointment is better than seeking from people.
Manual labour. with chastity is better than the riches of a vicious life.
A man is the best guard of his own secrets.
Often a man strives for what harms him.
He who speaks much speaks nonsense.
Associate with people of virtue; you will become one of them.
Keep aloof from people of vice; you will remain safe from them.
The worst food is that which is unlawful.
Oppressing the weak is the worst oppression.
Where leniency is unsuitable, harshness is lenience.
Often the ill-wisher gives correct advice
